### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

What are others saying about our impact? With operations in 70 countries, Cargill and our customers
are making news around the globe. Here a

## Infectious Disease and Oncology Research Applications

The needs for infectious disease and oncology research are evolving-and so is our technology. By
combining fully automated sequencing with intuitive software and bioinformatics pipelines, we've
created a comprehensive, turnkey next-generation sequencing platform that accelerates and advances
our understanding of pathogens and cancer. For Research Use Only. Not for use in diagnostic
procedures.
* #### Clear Dx®
  
  Oncology Research Applications [Learn About Oncology Research][41]
  open
  
  Meet Clear Dx®, an automated next-generation sequencing (NGS) platform designed to streamline
  oncology sequencing workflows. Clear Dx® automates key steps in library preparation and sequencing
  setup, reducing hands-on time while improving consistency and reproducibility across complex
  genomic assays. Clear Dx® is designed to support a wide range of oncology research workflows,
  including targeted sequencing of solid tumor samples, liquid biopsy applications, and fusion
  detection assays. By simplifying traditionally labor-intensive processes, the platform enables
  laboratories to efficiently generate high-quality sequencing libraries across multiple assay types
  while maintaining standardized performance. With automation that scales across diverse oncology
  workflows, Clear Dx® helps laboratories expand their genomic testing capabilities while
  accelerating time to insights. The platform also supports streamlined downstream data workflows
  through compatibility with secondary and tertiary bioinformatics platforms used for variant
  analysis, interpretation, and results reporting.
  
  [Oncology Research][42]
  * ##### Automated Library Preparation for Oncology Assays
    
    Automate complex library preparation workflows for oncology sequencing assays, reducing hands-on
    time while improving workflow consistency.
  * ##### Consistent and Reproducible Results
    
    Standardized automation minimizes variability and improves reproducibility across complex NGS
    workflows.
  * ##### Support for Diverse Oncology Workflows
    
    Run a variety of oncology research applications — including solid tumor sequencing, liquid
    biopsy workflows, and fusion detection — on a single automated platform.
  * ##### Streamlined Data Workflows
    
    Designed to integrate with secondary and tertiary bioinformatics platforms, enabling efficient
    analysis, interpretation, and reporting of genomic results.
* #### Clear Ix™
  
  Infectious Disease Research Applications [Learn About Infectious Disease Research][43]
  open
  
  Meet Clear Ix™, an automated next-generation sequencing (NGS) platform designed to accelerate
  infectious disease and microbial genomics research. Clear Ix™ streamlines complex sequencing
  workflows, enabling laboratories to generate high-quality genomic data with minimal hands-on time
  while improving consistency across runs. By automating key steps in microbial sequencing
  workflows, Clear Ix™ enables laboratories to efficiently characterize pathogens and generate
  genomic data for applications such as pathogen surveillance, microbial identification, and genomic
  epidemiology. Integrated software simplifies data handling and analysis, helping researchers move
  from sample to actionable insights more quickly.
  
  [Infectious Disease Research][44]
  * ##### Automated Pathogen Sequencing Workflows
    
    Streamline sequencing workflows for bacterial, viral, and fungal targets with automation
    designed for modern microbiology laboratories.
  * ##### Consistent and Reliable Results
    
    Standardized automation improves reproducibility and reduces manual variability across
    sequencing runs.
  * ##### Comprehensive Microbial Genomics Applications
    
    Support a wide range of infectious disease research use cases, including pathogen
    identification, microbial characterization, and genomic surveillance.
  * ##### Simplified Data Analysis
    
    Integrated software tools streamline data management and analysis, helping laboratories move
    efficiently from sample to genomic insight.

## Food Safety Testing Solutions

From identifying specific pathogen sources and strains, to helping companies gain greater
operational awareness, our unique tests leverage a next-generation sequencing (NGS) food safety
testing platform to ensure consumer safety.
* #### Clear Safety™
  
  Listeria & Salmonella Testing [Learn More][45]
  open
  
  Whether you’re looking to perform Salmonella serotyping or Listeria persistence monitoring, Clear
  Safety™ enables deep molecular characterization of pathogens—offering you the flexibility to find
  the right information for food safety environmental monitoring and quality assurance.
  
  [Learn About Clear Safety™][46]
  * ##### The Power of Data
    
    Increase operational efficiencies through better decision-making based on insights only
    achievable with next-generation sequencing (NGS).
  * ##### Automated Workflow
    
    Maintain reproducibility, reduce hands-on labor and minimize the potential for errors during
    Salmonella and Listeria sequencing with robotic pipetting and automated bioinformatics.
  * ##### Reliable Results
    
    Reduce false negatives and false positives—and curtail recall risks, operational costs, holding
    time, and short-shipping penalties for food safety and quality assurance.
  * ##### Environmental Mapping
    
    Understand contamination incidents and take more informed corrective actions with the ability to
    visualize your Listeria environmental monitoring program.

# [RipeTech Blog][2]

No-one to blame but myself

## [Feb 2026, long time no post][3]

There are various poor excuses why I have not posted in a long time. But the [Downloads and script
files][4] page has had quite a few additions.

The latest **pwScripter** (formerly known as **SQLite-OLE**) has been uploaded. It can be downloaded
from here [pwscripter][5]. It uses SQLite 3.51.2 so it is up-to-date (2026-02-17).

In addition, if you browse **YouTube** for **PlodWare** you will find 24 videos relating to PlodWare
/ pwScripter and even some Arduino related projects.

Author [Plod1066Ripe][6]Posted on [2026-02-172026-02-17][7]

## [New pwScripter][8]

The latest **pwScripter** (formerly known as **SQLite-OLE**) has been uploaded. It can be downloaded
from here [pwscripter][9]. It uses SQLite 3.46.1 so it is up-to-date (2024-09-18).

There is also a new web page for [downloads][10].

In addition, if you browse **YouTube** for **PlodWare** you will find 11 videos relating to PlodWare
/ pwScripter.

Author [Plod1066Ripe][11]Posted on [2024-09-18][12]

## [Another year gone, another update][13]

I have extensively reworked my application known as **PlodWare-SQLite-OLE,** and decided to *rename*
it to **pwScripter**. It can be downloaded from here [pwscripter][14].  It uses SQLite 3.46.0

The rework, **pwScripter**, is not 100% compatible with previous versions, so I need to update some
command scripts and web help pages.

There is also a new version of **PlodWare-MetaData-Tagger**. This is a pwScripter script of just
over 8000 lines (after empty lines and comments have been removed) that is compressed, encoded and
inserted in to a **pwScripter** executable, thus creating a standalone excutable that can be
downloaded here [PlodWare-MetaData-Tagger][15]

The full script for **PlodWare-MetaData-Tagger **is available here [pws-metadata-tagger][16]

Over the year I have added a fair bit of content using PHP and HTML to this web site, without using
WordPress. See [Alternative Content][17]

There is a much updated SQLite-OLE executable available [PlodWare-SQLite-OLE][21]

There is a  new PlodWare application available, for info about it click here [PlodWare Metadata
Tagger][22]

The latest version (2022-03-21) has the newest SQLite (3.38.1).

Not to sure why I did it, but I have have included the SQLite loadable extension **append.vfs**

I might find a good use for it, it seems interesting.

I have also made it possible to use the SQLite run-time loadable extension functionality . There is
a PWBasic command to switch the functionality on/off (default is off), whilst the actual accessing
of the target run-time loadable extension is controlled using a SQLite command .  I tested this with
various extensions ( including: uuid, SpatiaLite/mod_spatialite).

## [SQLite-OLE 2019-04-27][42]

New version of the SQLite and OLE tool for Windows.  Rightly or wrongly I am quite proud of this
tool. Whilst my colleagues are using Excel to do a lot of data analysis they are hitting problems
which are trivial in a SQL database environment.

Meanwhile I am running multiple instances of the SQLite-OLE tool on my laptop, often with databases
approaching 2 GByte in a single instance. Because the tool is ~ 95% command line orientated, it
forces me to create scripts. This has the massive advantage over a WIMP orientated tool because it
means that I automatically have a script that I can save and reuse/rerun at a later date and not
worry about “how did I do this last time”.

As a consequence of scripting I have found that I have adopted a “fire and forget” attitude. I focus
on a task, script it, save it, and then focus on the next task. I do not need to commit to human
memory the steps needed to complete a task. Given that I am running/developing scripts every day, I
find that “fire and forget”/ scripting frees me from worry.

The output of the various tasks is usually in a Excel file (for easy exchange with my colleagues),
the exporting of SQL query results to Excel is built in to the tool. Each Excel that I send out,
contains an Admin sheet that identifies the script used to create the Excel file.

So if I am asked to modify/update an Excel file I simply ask the requester to identify the script
(from the Admin sheet) and then I create a new version of the script and run it.

Some of the scripts are over 2000 lines long (with comments and lots of space to make it readable
and less visually frightening).

The scripting language has similarities with Microsoft VBA to minimize the learning curve, and as
the tool’s name implies it supports OLE.

What have you got to lose, go ahead and use it!

Author [Plod1066Ripe][40]Posted on [2019-08-072024-06-21][41]

## [SQLite-OLE 2019-04-27][42]

New version of the SQLite and OLE tool for Windows.  Rightly or wrongly I am quite proud of this
tool. Whilst my colleagues are using Excel to do a lot of data analysis they are hitting problems
which are trivial in a SQL database environment.

Meanwhile I am running multiple instances of the SQLite-OLE tool on my laptop, often with databases
approaching 2 GByte in a single instance. Because the tool is ~ 95% command line orientated, it
forces me to create scripts. This has the massive advantage over a WIMP orientated tool because it
means that I automatically have a script that I can save and reuse/rerun at a later date and not
worry about “how did I do this last time”.

As a consequence of scripting I have found that I have adopted a “fire and forget” attitude. I focus
on a task, script it, save it, and then focus on the next task. I do not need to commit to human
memory the steps needed to complete a task. Given that I am running/developing scripts every day, I
find that “fire and forget”/ scripting frees me from worry.

The output of the various tasks is usually in a Excel file (for easy exchange with my colleagues),
the exporting of SQL query results to Excel is built in to the tool. Each Excel that I send out,
contains an Admin sheet that identifies the script used to create the Excel file.

So if I am asked to modify/update an Excel file I simply ask the requester to identify the script
(from the Admin sheet) and then I create a new version of the script and run it.

Some of the scripts are over 2000 lines long (with comments and lots of space to make it readable
and less visually frightening).

The scripting language has similarities with Microsoft VBA to minimize the learning curve, and as
the tool’s name implies it supports OLE.

What have you got to lose, go ahead and use it!

### Keep track of the location, condition, and ETA of your cargo.

The strength and security of your supply chain has never been more important. Stay resilient with
accurate, real-time data and Savi’s machine intelligence. Learn how in-transit visibility can help
you navigate disruption and uncertainty.

[Request a Demo][5]

 

Serving Your Industry

[**GOVERNMENT & MILITARY**][6]

 

### Solutions to Improve Your Supply Chain


[**Get Real-Time Visibility**][7]

See where your goods are at all times, even over ocean.


[**Tighten Security**][8]

Find blind spots, obstacles and threats.


[**Understand Performance**][9]

Use accurate, impartial data for smarter insights and strategy.


[**Improve Agility**][10]

Respond faster with better data.

[See our solutions][11]

### Solving customers’ supply chain challenges

We work with you to identify issues early to minimize impacts. Using our Internet of Things (IoT)
sensors & active RFID (aRFID) tags helps reduce human error.

Sensors monitor environmental conditions and capture other crucial information to ensure your most
valuable, perishable and/or sensitive shipments arrive secure and intact, at the lowest cost.

 

[The Value of Knowing][12]

**Raise Customer Satisfaction** • **Improve Performance** • **Lower Risk** • **Gain Competitive
Advantage**

 

**Technology**

[Live streaming data from our superior, low-cost sensors provide continuous active learning to
enhance visibility and security. Learn more »][13]

**Expertise**

[For over 30 years, we’ve powered the world’s largest, most complex supply chain for the U.S.
military and its allies, and supply chains for over a thousand global commercial companies. Learn
more »][14]

### [Solutions Powered by IoT/Machine Learning][15]

Superior data yields powerful results for our customers. We help businesses streamline supply chain
operations, improve strategic planning and boost profitability.

[Agricultural balance][7]

# [Producing better and sustainably][8]

[Ecological commitment][9]

## [A complete analysis of organic farming][10]

Respectful of the environment and health, organic farming is based on agricultural practices that
exclude synthetic chemicals and promote natural balances. It aims to preserve [soil fertility][11],
[biodiversity][12], and [animal welfare][13], while meeting growing consumer demand for healthy and
sustainable products. However, it faces several challenges: sometimes lower yields, certification
constraints, higher production costs, and the structuring of supply chains. Faced with these
challenges, organic farming is a path for the future, provided it reconciles ecological
requirements, economic viability, and accessibility for all.

[A complete analysis of organic farming]

[Crop planning and rotation][14]

## [Strategic land management][15]

Planning your crops is a key step in optimizing land use. A well-thought-out rotation helps preserve
soil fertility, limit [disease][16], and improve long-term yields. This strategic management
requires taking into account plant needs, production cycles, and local conditions.

[Agroforestry]

### [Agroforestry][17]

This technique involves combining trees, crops, and/or livestock on the same plot.

[Mulching]

### [Mulching][18]

Mulching involves covering the soil around the plants with organic materials (straw, leaves, wood
chips) or minerals.

[Strip cropping ]

### [Strip cropping][19]

This method involves growing different crops in parallel strips on the same plot.

[Innovation in agriculture][20]

## Towards more sustainable and efficient production

Innovation in agriculture is profoundly transforming farming practices, integrating technological
advances and scientific knowledge to meet current challenges. It aims to increase yields while
reducing environmental impact, improve resource management, and ensure food security in the face of
a growing world population. Machines such as [tractors][21], [silage defacers][22], and [silage
block cutters][23] illustrate this progress, enabling farmers to work more efficiently while
reducing labor intensity and feed losses.

[Digital technologies and precision agriculture]

### [Digital technologies and precision agriculture][24]

The use of drones, sensors, GPS, and specialized software enables precise management of agricultural
plots.

[Biotechnologies and crop improvement]

### Biotechnologies and crop improvement

[Biotechnologies ][25]offer solutions for developing plant varieties that are resistant to disease
and climate stress, or more nutritious.

[Short supply chains][26]

## Promoting fresh produce and better agricultural remuneration

Short supply chains, which promote[ direct sales from producer to consumer][27], are gaining
popularity. They reduce middlemen, increase farmers’ remuneration, and offer fresh, local products
to consumers. This trend helps boost rural economies and meet growing expectations for transparency
and quality.

Agricultural crops

## [Essential basis of food production][28]

Agricultural crops encompass all the techniques and practices aimed at producing plants for human
and animal consumption, or other industrial uses. It is based on the selection of species, soil
preparation, water and [nutrient management][29], as well as protection against [pests ][30]and
diseases.

[Cereal crops ]

### [Cereal crops][31]

Cereals, such as wheat, corn, and rice, are the most widely grown crops in the world, essential for
global food security and nutrition.

[Market gardening ]

### [Market gardening][32]

Market gardening includes vegetables and fruits grown in small or large areas, often close to where
they are consumed.

[Permanent crops ]

### [Permanent crops][33]

Permanent crops, such as orchards, vineyards, or olive groves, involve plants grown over several
years without annual replanting.

[Livestock production][34]

## A key pillar of global agriculture

Livestock production plays a central role in global agriculture, providing essential resources such
as meat, milk, eggs, and other by-products. It not only contributes to the nutrition of billions of
people, but also contributes to the rural economy by generating income and jobs. Despite its many
benefits, this sector currently faces major challenges related to environmental impact,
sustainability of livestock systems and animal welfare. For instance, even the choice of [feeding

# [Producing better and sustainably][8]

[Ecological commitment][9]

## [A complete analysis of organic farming][10]

Respectful of the environment and health, organic farming is based on agricultural practices that
exclude synthetic chemicals and promote natural balances. It aims to preserve [soil fertility][11],
[biodiversity][12], and [animal welfare][13], while meeting growing consumer demand for healthy and
sustainable products. However, it faces several challenges: sometimes lower yields, certification
constraints, higher production costs, and the structuring of supply chains. Faced with these
challenges, organic farming is a path for the future, provided it reconciles ecological
requirements, economic viability, and accessibility for all.

[A complete analysis of organic farming]

[Crop planning and rotation][14]

## [Strategic land management][15]

Planning your crops is a key step in optimizing land use. A well-thought-out rotation helps preserve
soil fertility, limit [disease][16], and improve long-term yields. This strategic management
requires taking into account plant needs, production cycles, and local conditions.

[Agroforestry]

### [Agroforestry][17]

This technique involves combining trees, crops, and/or livestock on the same plot.

[Mulching]

### [Mulching][18]

Mulching involves covering the soil around the plants with organic materials (straw, leaves, wood
chips) or minerals.

[Strip cropping ]

### [Strip cropping][19]

This method involves growing different crops in parallel strips on the same plot.

[Innovation in agriculture][20]

## Towards more sustainable and efficient production

Innovation in agriculture is profoundly transforming farming practices, integrating technological
advances and scientific knowledge to meet current challenges. It aims to increase yields while
reducing environmental impact, improve resource management, and ensure food security in the face of
a growing world population. Machines such as [tractors][21], [silage defacers][22], and [silage
block cutters][23] illustrate this progress, enabling farmers to work more efficiently while
reducing labor intensity and feed losses.

[Digital technologies and precision agriculture]

### [Digital technologies and precision agriculture][24]

The use of drones, sensors, GPS, and specialized software enables precise management of agricultural
plots.

[Biotechnologies and crop improvement]

### Biotechnologies and crop improvement

[Biotechnologies ][25]offer solutions for developing plant varieties that are resistant to disease
and climate stress, or more nutritious.

[Short supply chains][26]

## Promoting fresh produce and better agricultural remuneration

Short supply chains, which promote[ direct sales from producer to consumer][27], are gaining
popularity. They reduce middlemen, increase farmers’ remuneration, and offer fresh, local products
to consumers. This trend helps boost rural economies and meet growing expectations for transparency
and quality.

Agricultural crops

## [Essential basis of food production][28]

Agricultural crops encompass all the techniques and practices aimed at producing plants for human
and animal consumption, or other industrial uses. It is based on the selection of species, soil
preparation, water and [nutrient management][29], as well as protection against [pests ][30]and
diseases.

[Cereal crops ]

### [Cereal crops][31]

Cereals, such as wheat, corn, and rice, are the most widely grown crops in the world, essential for
global food security and nutrition.

[Market gardening ]

### [Market gardening][32]

Market gardening includes vegetables and fruits grown in small or large areas, often close to where
they are consumed.

[Permanent crops ]

### [Permanent crops][33]

Permanent crops, such as orchards, vineyards, or olive groves, involve plants grown over several
years without annual replanting.

[Livestock production][34]

## A key pillar of global agriculture

Livestock production plays a central role in global agriculture, providing essential resources such
as meat, milk, eggs, and other by-products. It not only contributes to the nutrition of billions of
people, but also contributes to the rural economy by generating income and jobs. Despite its many
benefits, this sector currently faces major challenges related to environmental impact,
sustainability of livestock systems and animal welfare. For instance, even the choice of [feeding
bucket][35] can influence animal welfare, as well-designed models help reduce stress, competition,
and injuries during feeding.

[Understanding the agri-food sector ]

From field to fork

## [Understanding the agri-food sector][36]

The agri-food sector encompasses all the steps involved in transforming agricultural raw materials
into finished products for consumption. This ranges from crop and livestock production to industrial
processing, including storage, distribution, and marketing. Each link in this chain plays a crucial
role in ensuring food quality, safety, and [traceability][37]. Faced with growing consumer
expectations for health, sustainability, and transparency, the sector must constantly innovate while
adhering to strict standards.

[Working the land][38]

## [Indispensable traditional farming tools][39]

[The hoe]

### [The hoe][40]

A tool with a flat or curved blade attached to a handle, used for weeding, hoeing, loosening the
soil, and weeding around crops.

[The garden fork]

### [The garden fork][41]

A tool with sturdy tines, ideal for turning over the soil, breaking up clods, and aerating the soil
without completely turning it over.

[The rake]

### [The rake][42]

Used to level the soil, collect plant debris, or level plots after tillage, improving seedbed
quality and preparing for sowing.

[agricultural synergies]

National agricultural policies, such as subsidies, production quotas, and regulations, play a
crucial role in structuring local markets.

Tractor

Combine harvester

Sprayer

Seeder

Planting types

Row planting

Pocket planting

Espalier planting

Strip planting

Precision agriculture

Precision agriculture uses advanced technologies to optimize field operations, thereby improving
yields and sustainability while reducing environmental impacts.

Towards a complete agriculture.

## Digitalizing Every Level of AgriFood Value Chain

[AGRIVI Rješenja za Poljoprivredu]

**Empowering Agriculture with AI**

## AGRIVI Product Family

Comprehensive digital agriculture solutions empower growers and agrifood companies across the value
chain with AI and data-driven tools to produce healthy, safe, and nutritious food in an efficient
and sustainable way.

**AGRIVI** AI

Engage

Innovative AI-advisory platform, tailor-made to support agrifood companies to engage and nurture
strong relationships with farmers by bringing agriculture knowledge and advice via white-labeled
WhatsApp or Viber AI agronomic advisor.

[Book A Meeting][42]
[Learn More][43]

**AGRIVI** 360 Farm Management Software

Farm Enterprise

Market leading farm management software supporting farmers with data-driven tools and real-time
insights from the field to make precise agronomic and economic decisions and maximize productivity
and profitability.

[Book A Meeting][44]
[Learn More][45]

**AGRIVI** Food

Traceability

Digital solution for complete food production traceability, by giving food and retail companies the
ability to provide transparent insight into the lifecycle of fresh or processed food products to the
end customers, from seed to shelves.

[Book A Meeting][46]
[Learn More][47]
[View All Products][48]

**AGRIVI** Connect

## Monitor All Your Data from One Place in Real-Time

AGRIVI offers complete interoperability for all your machinery, IoT and ERP. Seamlessly connect and
synchronize your weather station, soil sensors or machines and collect and manage all data from the
fields in one place. Simple plug & play integration to **AGRIVI farm management platform for
real-time and precise agricultural data monitoring**.

[Learn More][49]

## INDUSTRIES

Our digital agriculture solutions are tailor-made to support all stakeholders of the agrifood value
chain. Discover the best solution for your industry.

## ENTERPRISE FARMS

Enterprise farming holdings and
agribusiness companies with
large and complex operations.

[LEARN MORE][50]

## FOOD & BEVERAGES

Food and beverage companies with direct farmer contracting and sustainable supply chain strategies.

[LEARN MORE][51]

## RETAIL

Retail chains with their own or contracted crop production to market premium fresh products in
stores.

[LEARN MORE][52]

## INPUT MANUFACTURERS

Manufacturers of seeds, crop protection products, fertilizers, and machinery with large pool of
customers.

[LEARN MORE][53]
[View All Industries][54]

## The Operating System for African Agriculture

We are a data-driven company empowering farmers, processors, and investors to build a profitable and
sustainable agricultural future. Through expert consulting and innovative technology, we connect
every link in the value chain.

[ Learn More ][22]
[ Explore Agtrail ][23]

Supported & Trusted by

Our Vision

#### A Connected, Sustainable African Agribusiness

Agrolinking envisions a vibrant African agribusiness ecosystem where every farmer, processor, and
stakeholder thrives. We connect through data-rich networks, champion sustainable practices, and
forge transparent market linkages, ultimately fueling food security, economic empowerment, and
environmental resilience across the continent.

Value

#### From Data to Decisions,
#### From Farm to Fork

Agrolinking envisions a vibrant African agribusiness ecosystem where every farmer, processor, and
stakeholder thrives, able practices, and forge transparent market linkages, ultimately fueling food
security, economic empowerment, and environmental resilience across the continent.

#### For Agribusinesses

**Build, grow, and scale ** with confidence through our expert business consulting and
investment-readiness support.

#### For Farmers & Cooperatives

** Unlock capital, improve yields, and access premium markets **with our data tools and
capacity-building programs

#### For Investors & Partners

** De-risk your investments and drive measurable** impact with data-driven strategies and
transparent reporting.

About

#### We built Agrolinking because we’ve been in your shoes!

Our journey didn't start with a business plan; it started with a shared feeling. We’ve stood in the
fields, walked the markets, and talked to the investors. We've felt the disconnects firsthand. We
built Agrolinking to weave together the threads we knew were missing, because we've experienced what
happens when they're not there.

#### We’ve seen the harvest spoiled by a broken thread to the market.

We know the heartache of a farmer who has poured everything into their crop, only to see its value
diminish due to a lack of steady buyers or post-harvest losses.

#### We've tried to build trust with nothing but a handshake.

We understand the challenge of proving your product’s quality and safety when your story is
invisible. In a world that demands proof, a simple promise isn't enough to unlock premium markets or
earn a consumer's unwavering loyalty.

#### We've worked in the dark, wishing for a thread of clear insight.

We know what it’s like to make critical decisions about resources, timing, and strategy based on
incomplete information or gut feelings. We’ve seen how this lack of data-driven clarity leads to
inefficiency and missed opportunities across the entire value chain.

#### We’ve felt the frustration of a brilliant vision held back by a missing financial thread.

We know the feeling of having a game-changing idea for a processing facility or a new agribusiness,
but being unable to secure the capital because the financial world sees agriculture as too complex
or risky.

#### Agtrail...

went straight to the source.

FAQs

#### Frequently Asked Questions

Agrolinking envisions a vibrant African agribusiness ecosystem where every farmer, processor, and
stakeholder thrives.

#### [ What does Agrolinking do in simple terms? ][25]

We are **expert guides for African agribusiness**. We provide both the **strategic maps (Business
Consulting)** to help organizations plan their route to success, and the **advanced navigational
instruments (Data Services, AgTrail, AgSur)** to help them execute that journey with precision,
safety, and profitability.

#### [ What makes Agrolinking different from other agritech companies or consultants? ][26]

Our key difference is our integrated approach. We don't just offer technology or just give advice.
We combine **deep, on-the-ground field experience** with cutting-edge data science and technology.
We understand both the soil and the signal, which allows us to chart uniquely practical and powerful
courses for our partners.

#### [ Are you a non-profit organization? ][27]

Agrolinking is a **for-profit social enterprise**. This means we operate as a sustainable business,
but our core mission is to create positive social and environmental impact. Profitability allows us
to scale our impact, invest in new innovations, and continue our voyage to build a stronger
agricultural backbone for Africa.

#### [ Do you only operate in Nigeria? ][28]

While our journey began and our headquarters are in Nigeria, our vision and solutions are designed
for the entire African continent. We are actively expanding our operations and partnerships into
several other African countries. If you have a project outside Nigeria, we encourage you
to [**contact our partnerships team**][29].

#### [ How can my organization partner with Agrolinking? ][30]

We are always looking for partners to join our voyage! Whether you are a development agency, an
investor, a research institution, or a large corporation, we have multiple avenues for
collaboration. The best way to start is by sending a dispatch to our partnerships team
at **[[email protected]][31]**.

#### Frequently Asked Questions

#### [ What does Agrolinking do in simple terms? ][25]

We are **expert guides for African agribusiness**. We provide both the **strategic maps (Business
Consulting)** to help organizations plan their route to success, and the **advanced navigational
instruments (Data Services, AgTrail, AgSur)** to help them execute that journey with precision,
safety, and profitability.

#### [ What makes Agrolinking different from other agritech companies or consultants? ][26]

Our key difference is our integrated approach. We don't just offer technology or just give advice.
We combine **deep, on-the-ground field experience** with cutting-edge data science and technology.
We understand both the soil and the signal, which allows us to chart uniquely practical and powerful
courses for our partners.

#### [ Are you a non-profit organization? ][27]

Agrolinking is a **for-profit social enterprise**. This means we operate as a sustainable business,
but our core mission is to create positive social and environmental impact. Profitability allows us
to scale our impact, invest in new innovations, and continue our voyage to build a stronger
agricultural backbone for Africa.

#### [ Do you only operate in Nigeria? ][28]

While our journey began and our headquarters are in Nigeria, our vision and solutions are designed
for the entire African continent. We are actively expanding our operations and partnerships into
several other African countries. If you have a project outside Nigeria, we encourage you
to [**contact our partnerships team**][29].

#### [ How can my organization partner with Agrolinking? ][30]

We are always looking for partners to join our voyage! Whether you are a development agency, an
investor, a research institution, or a large corporation, we have multiple avenues for
collaboration. The best way to start is by sending a dispatch to our partnerships team
at **[[email protected]][31]**.

# Food Traceability

In today's world, consumers are becoming increasingly concerned about the safety and quality of the 
food they eat. Food traceability is becoming a critical issue for food manufacturers, retailers and 
consumers alike. A food traceability application is a valuable tool that can help ensure the safety 
and quality of the food supply chain.

### FoodIDentics

FoodIDentics is a Supply Chain Service (SaaS) using lot numbers and serialization to manage
inventory and provide fast and efficient product recall when product liability issues arise.

With FoodIDentics, bar codes are attached to the product (catch weight/net weight) during the
receiving and production process, does rule based product put-away, fills orders, ships and tracks
product into your customer’s hands. RFID at the pallet, case and each level is our next enhancement.
Our ultimate goal in every project is synchronize supply, demand and inventory using standards from
GS1, GS1 Synchronization, Lean Principles and Process Analysis.

Ames & McBain has been a lifesaver for our business. Their food traceability and warehouse managemen
t system has allowed us to streamline our operations and improve efficiency. We are now able to keep
 track of our inventory in real-time, enabling us to make smarter decisions and ensure our customers
 get the freshest product possible. Highly recommend!

We combine human ingenuity with artificial intelligence to deliver [ custom software

value. Whether modernizing legacy systems or implementing new AI capabilities, we help you move

deploy technology, they use their deep industry experience to align it with your strategic goals.

## Our Top AI & Digital Solutions Built for Your Business

### Construction AI

Harness AI-driven analytics and automation to optimize project planning, resource allocation, and
safety compliance. Our solutions help construction firms reduce costs, improve timelines, and
deliver smarter, sustainable builds.

[SMART CONSTRUCTION SOLUTIONS][177]

### Healthcare AI

Empower healthcare organizations with AI tools for predictive analytics, patient engagement, and
regulatory compliance. Enhance care quality, streamline workflows, and accelerate innovation across
healthcare operations.

[INTEGRATE AI IN HEALTHCARE][178]

### AI Automation

Automate repetitive processes with intuitive, reliable workflows that boost efficiency and accuracy.
From back-office operations to customer service, our AI automation solutions cut costs and help
eliminate time constraints for your team.

[SCALE WITH AI AUTOMATION][179]

### Dedicated Development Teams

Scale your software projects with on-demand, specialized development teams. We provide vetted
experts who will integrate seamlessly with your business and processes, ensuring faster delivery,
flexibility, and enterprise-grade quality.

[ACCESS TEAM OF EXPERTS][180]

### AI-Ready CRM Development

Transform customer engagement with AI-powered CRM solutions. We provide actionable insights,
automate sales processes, and create personalized experiences to drive loyalty and revenue growth.

[TRANSFORM CRM WITH SALESFORCE][181]

### Custom ERP Solutions

Streamline enterprise operations with tailored ERP systems designed for scalability and compliance.
Our solutions unify data, automate workflows, and deliver real-time visibility for more intelligent
decision-making.

[UNIFY ERP PLATFORMS][182]

### HCM Managed Services

Optimize workforce management with AI-enabled HCM solutions. From payroll benefits to talent
analytics, we deliver tools that improve both the employee experience and operational efficiency.

[TRANSFORM HR SYSTEMS][183]

### AI-Augmented BPM

Implement AI to automate complex decision-making within your Business Process Management (BPM)
workflows, increasing speed and quality beyond what traditional automation can achieve.

[AI BPM SOLUTIONS][184]

### Agentic Intelligence

Build autonomous AI agents capable of planning, executing, and monitoring complex, multi-step tasks
across diverse platforms without human intervention.

[DEPLOY AUTONOMOUS AI AGENTS][185]

### AI-First Payments

Integrate AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics into payment systems for superior fraud
detection, compliance management, and transaction efficiency.

[MODERNIZE PAYMENTS WITH AI][186]

### ER&D

Leverage AI for simulation, modeling, and rapid prototyping with full-cycle Engineering Research and
Development (ER&D) services.

[POWER YOUR ER&D TEAMS][187]

### Data Integration

Architect robust data pipelines and ecosystems to unify disparate data sources, ensuring clean,
accessible data for accurate AI modeling and decision-making.

[CONNECT YOUR DATA][188]

### Data Management

Optimize your data infrastructure with comprehensive services for governance, storage, security, and
quality to support scalable AI and digital initiatives.

[VIEW DATA SOLUTIONS][189]

### PLM

Develop and enhance Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems that automate product development,
manufacturing, and regulatory compliance.

[EXPLORE PLM SOLUTIONS][190]

### Esri ArcGIS Migration

Execute specialized migration and integration services for Esri's ArcGIS platform, ensuring seamless
transition, data integrity, and optimal performance for your mission-critical GIS applications.

[EXPLORE ESRI GIS SOLUTION][191]

# Bringing visibility to global food systems.

### We’re working to (en)able supply chain visibility in food systems so businesses and consumers
### can make better, more responsible decisions.

# ***(en)***

### **prefix meaning ‘to cause something to be’**

The sheer volume of global trade is causing the journey and authenticity of our food to become
largely opaque. At (en)visible we exist to add visibility to global food systems allowing brands and
consumers to make more informed decisions and change their behaviors for good.

[Seafood traceability]

## **Product Stories & Traceability**

Food traceability is becoming a regulatory requirement and is an essential step toward data driven
supply chains. We work with [blockchain][14] and other technologies to enable supply chain actors to
communicate the story and attributes of their food products.

[Responsible Seafood Sourcing]

## **Responsible Sourcing**

Restaurants, retailers and food product brands struggle to find and verify responsibly produced
seafood. We work directly with producers using various technologies to ensure integrity and
communicate product stories to consumers.

[Sustainable Food Programs]

## **Sustainability Programs**

Sustainability programs typically require alignment and coordination among a variety of stakeholders
in order to succeed. Our team has in-depth experience planning and executing sustainability programs
in multiple countries throughout the world.

[Consumer Engagement]

## **Consumer Engagement**

Today’s consumers want to know the story behind their food. We use a combination of technology and
program planning to enable retailers and producers to engage consumers and communicate the story and
unique attributes of their products.

### can make better, more responsible decisions.

# ***(en)***

### **prefix meaning ‘to cause something to be’**

The sheer volume of global trade is causing the journey and authenticity of our food to become
largely opaque. At (en)visible we exist to add visibility to global food systems allowing brands and
consumers to make more informed decisions and change their behaviors for good.

[Seafood traceability]

## **Product Stories & Traceability**

Food traceability is becoming a regulatory requirement and is an essential step toward data driven
supply chains. We work with [blockchain][14] and other technologies to enable supply chain actors to
communicate the story and attributes of their food products.

[Responsible Seafood Sourcing]

## **Responsible Sourcing**

Restaurants, retailers and food product brands struggle to find and verify responsibly produced
seafood. We work directly with producers using various technologies to ensure integrity and
communicate product stories to consumers.

[Sustainable Food Programs]

## **Sustainability Programs**

Sustainability programs typically require alignment and coordination among a variety of stakeholders
in order to succeed. Our team has in-depth experience planning and executing sustainability programs
in multiple countries throughout the world.

[Consumer Engagement]

## **Consumer Engagement**

Today’s consumers want to know the story behind their food. We use a combination of technology and
program planning to enable retailers and producers to engage consumers and communicate the story and
unique attributes of their products.

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## Supply Chain Management

What are the main benefits of Foods Connected for the supply chain?

Foods Connected simplifies the food supply chain by optimising spend and unlocking the data that
food manufacturers, retailers and distributors need to excel. Our tools make it as easy as possible
for our customers to manage and report on supply chain traceability, product lifecycle management,
procurement, food safety and quality control and sustainability. 

Can Foods Connected help manage and improve supply chains outside of the food industry?

While our technology is designed primarily to help food industry businesses, it can be used by
anyone who wants to improve their supply chain solutions. One of the main selling points of our
software is that it is adaptable; not only can we cater to the needs of specific teams such as
procurement or technology, we also deliver the added benefit of bringing siloed data together across
departments and sites into a single source of truth. This improves supply chain visibility by
facilitating collaboration and helps customers make better business-wide decisions.

How can I get my suppliers using Foods Connected?

Foods Connected’s supply chain management platform is both simple and user-friendly for both
customers and suppliers. For suppliers, one of the key benefits is removing duplicated effort and
admin, with data such as SAQs, Specs or standards and certifications like BRC, Red Tractor, GMP,
HACCP, ISO 22000, or SQFI only needing to be managed once. The software also has built-in automated
reminders and triggers to encourage engagement by all stakeholders to your business. 

## Solutions

## Providing you with the tools to become
## **a more successful and sustainable business.**

Supplier Compliance Quality Management Product Lifecycle Management Procurement Sustainability
Solutions Optimise Track & Trace Trends & Insights

## Supplier Compliance

## Manage your supply chain risk with transparency and real-time compliance

Foods Connected makes maintaining supplier compliance easy, reducing risk and improving
relationships. Our software enables you to streamline supplier onboarding, simplify supplier risk
management, and automate compliance tracking all in one place, ensuring suppliers always meet your
business requirements.

## Quality Management

## Improve product quality and eradicate visibility issues with our integrated system

Our quality management solutions provide real-time quality insights, so you can audit, check, risk
assess and log incidents to improve product quality throughout your supply chain. With Foods
Connected, you can maintain quality consistency, while optimising production and minimising waste.

## Product Lifecycle Management

## Manage product specifications, optimise critical paths and automate workflows

Our product lifecycle management solutions keep you ahead of the competition. They accelerate
innovation and unblock bottlenecks, keeping your NPD moving, so you can bring your products to
market faster and maintain accurate controls on product specifications in real time.

## Procurement

## Achieve cost-of-goods saving with this time-efficient bird’s-eye view of your entire procurement
## process

Our efficient flexible solutions are designed as a tool set for procurement teams to confidently
manage procurement supply chains, streamlining process, while reducing risk and cost. With this one
source of truth providing assured continuity, you can automate procurement processes, manage
negotiations, orders and contracts, and streamline your service level to the customer, guaranteeing
reduced end-to-end costs of between 2-10%.

## Sustainability Solutions

## Stay socially and environmentally responsible with our expert services and data-driven insights

Foods Connected solutions are designed to address the bigger sustainability and governance picture,
supporting your initiatives and improving your supply chain transparency. We advise on on-site
solutions, inform on policy developments and share industry insights, while our software empowers
you to measure and reduce your environmental impact and monitor supplier sustainability, all the
while driving growth and profitability.

## Optimise

## Track and trend your production process critical path with profitable results

Foods Connected helps you achieve cost of goods savings through better data modelling. We work with
your business to give you clarity across your entire production process, making sense of the cost
dynamics that make up your products. Using our solutions, you can balance the components of your
supply chain budgets, boosting yields and reducing volatility, to establish a more sustainable and
efficient cost model.

for our customers to manage and report on supply chain traceability, product lifecycle management,
procurement, food safety and quality control and sustainability. 

Can Foods Connected help manage and improve supply chains outside of the food industry?

While our technology is designed primarily to help food industry businesses, it can be used by
anyone who wants to improve their supply chain solutions. One of the main selling points of our
software is that it is adaptable; not only can we cater to the needs of specific teams such as
procurement or technology, we also deliver the added benefit of bringing siloed data together across

facilitating collaboration and helps customers make better business-wide decisions.

# Making sure you're not a bot!

Loading...

You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up Anubis to protect the
server against the scourge of AI companies aggressively scraping websites. This can and does cause
downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone.

Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a Proof-of-Work scheme in the vein of Hashcash, a proposed
proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional
load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive.

Ultimately, this is a placeholder solution so that more time can be spent on fingerprinting and
identifying headless browsers (EG: via how they do font rendering) so that the challenge proof of
work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate.

Please note that Anubis requires the use of modern JavaScript features that plugins like JShelter
will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain.

Sadly, you must enable JavaScript to get past this challenge. This is required because AI companies
have changed the social contract around how website hosting works. A no-JS solution is a
work-in-progress.

Protected by [Anubis][1] From [Techaro][2].

Mascot design by [CELPHASE][3].

This website is running Anubis version `devel`.

[1]: https://github.com/TecharoHQ/anubis
[2]: https://techaro.lol
[3]: https://bsky.app/profile/celphase.bsky.social

# Making sure you're not a bot!

Loading...

You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up Anubis to protect the
server against the scourge of AI companies aggressively scraping websites. This can and does cause
downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone.

Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a Proof-of-Work scheme in the vein of Hashcash, a proposed
proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional
load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive.

Ultimately, this is a placeholder solution so that more time can be spent on fingerprinting and
identifying headless browsers (EG: via how they do font rendering) so that the challenge proof of
work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate.

Please note that Anubis requires the use of modern JavaScript features that plugins like JShelter
will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain.

Sadly, you must enable JavaScript to get past this challenge. This is required because AI companies
have changed the social contract around how website hosting works. A no-JS solution is a
work-in-progress.

## Question

## Answer

###### How long does it take to get set up?

Depends on your documents and how ready your team is — but AI moves fast. Teams are typically live
within a couple of days of uploading their files. Every new client gets a personal 30-minute setup
call where we build the system using their actual documents, not templates.

###### Do I need to enter all my data manually?

No. IONI reads your existing SOPs, HACCP plans, recipes, and supplier certificates and builds the
system from them. Nothing to enter by hand.

###### Which certifications does IONI support?

IONI works with any standard your retailer or regulator requires — SQF, BRCGS, FSMA, CFIA, FSSC
22000, and others. If you're preparing for a specific standard and want to confirm coverage, ask on
the setup call.

###### What if my operators aren't tech-savvy?

The operator screen shows only the tasks for their shift — a short checklist on tablet or phone. No
training required. If they can use WhatsApp, they can use IONI.

###### Can I switch from another system?

Yes. Upload your existing SOPs and HACCP files — IONI reads them and rebuilds everything
automatically. No manual re-entry.

###### How is IONI different from hiring a food safety consultant?

A consultant writes your HACCP plan once and leaves. IONI keeps the whole system running —
digitizing daily checks, tracking supplier certificates, pulling audit reports in one click.

Who We Are

## Big farm, on an even **bigger mission**.

On **3.278 hectares** of **organically certified** arable land, we produce organic crops at yields
that match or even surpass conventional farming.

[ View our harvest results ][61]

What We Do

## We grow **staple crops** - the biggest source of calories in the human diet.

Here’s what we’re growing in 2025/2026.
* Oat
  
  959 ha
* Sunflower
  
  729 ha
* Peas
  
  690 ha
* Wheat
  
  324 ha
* Flax
  
  276 ha
* Chickpeas
  
  298 ha

## Our farm exists to prove sustainable farming works at scale.

It’s where we develop, test, and improve practical solutions that anyone can apply.

[ BUY OUR CROPS ][62]

HOW WE DO IT

## We test in our fields, then share what works.

  ][66]

WHY WE DO IT

## People and the planet depend on change.

The way food is grown today is damaging our health, the soil, ecosystems, and food security.  We’re
proving a better way is possible, and sharing it freely so change can spread faster.

[ READ FULL STORY ][67]

### Healthy food for **everyone means**
* #### **Food that’s accessible,** not a privilege.
* #### **Farming that protects,** not depletes.
* #### **Soil that stays alive** for future harvests.

The [Login5 Foundation][68] makes it possible to share our solutions for free.

> “Being a father myself, our mistreatment of the Earth and the exploitation of its natural
> resources started to concern me. **How will the future look for my grandkids?**”

Samo Login,

Founder

Who We Are

## Big farm, on an even **bigger mission**.

On **3.278 hectares** of **organically certified** arable land, we produce organic crops at yields
that match or even surpass conventional farming.

[ View our harvest results ][61]

What We Do

## We grow **staple crops** - the biggest source of calories in the human diet.

Here’s what we’re growing in 2025/2026.
* Oat
  
  959 ha
* Sunflower
  
  729 ha
* Peas
  
  690 ha
* Wheat
  
  324 ha
* Flax
  
  276 ha
* Chickpeas
  
  298 ha

## Our farm exists to prove sustainable farming works at scale.

It’s where we develop, test, and improve practical solutions that anyone can apply.

[ BUY OUR CROPS ][62]

HOW WE DO IT

## We test in our fields, then share what works.
* Sustainable farming
* FARMING SOFTWARE
* TRACEABILITY
* FOOD DEVELOPMENT
* [
  
  ### Sustainable farming methods that **prove organic can thrive at scale.**
  
  ][63]
* [
  
  ### Farming software that makes farm management **simple and efficient.**
  
  ][64]
* [
  
  ### Traceability that builds trust, from the **seed to the final product.**
  
  ][65]
* [
  
  ### Food innovations that show **plant-based food** can be convenient and healthy.
  
  ][66]

WHY WE DO IT

## People and the planet depend on change.

The way food is grown today is damaging our health, the soil, ecosystems, and food security.  We’re
proving a better way is possible, and sharing it freely so change can spread faster.

[ READ FULL STORY ][67]

### Healthy food for **everyone means**
* #### **Food that’s accessible,** not a privilege.
* #### **Farming that protects,** not depletes.
* #### **Soil that stays alive** for future harvests.

The [Login5 Foundation][68] makes it possible to share our solutions for free.

> “Being a father myself, our mistreatment of the Earth and the exploitation of its natural
> resources started to concern me. **How will the future look for my grandkids?**”

Samo Login,

Founder

## Sonaria, Our Proprietary Track and Trace Solution

Unified Visibility

Sonaria provides a one stop hub for all of your inventory and asset tracking systems. 

Combining insights from various technologies including barcode, Bluetooth, ultrawideband, and RFID,
asset tracking with Sonaria is a breeze.

Generate reports both with native data as well as data pulled in from other sources. Get real-time
location tracking, lifecycle management, and process automation, all with a user-friendly interface.

[Smart warehouse management system]
[Factory engineer hold tablet manage inventory control]

### Easy Integration

Sonaria easily integrates with your existing management and financial systems. Connect your
Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software, Warehouse Management Software (WMS), and other types of
management software through REST APIs and custom integrations.

Lowry Solutions will install and configure Sonaria to your business’s specifications. We understand
that every business is different, and we want to tailor our software to your unique needs.

Save Time and Money

With Sonaria’s asset tracking system, you can maintain the performance of your assets and inventory
across your enterprise. 

Reduce inventory search time, manage asset repair schedules, and manage inventory levels in one
track and trace solution.

Lowry Solutions is committed to adding value to your enterprise. Our solutions are designed to
leverage multiple technologies to streamline your production and distribution processes.

[Mobile Device Management]

### Get Started With an Inventory and Asset Tracking Solution from Lowry

Improve your asset and inventory tracking methods with our reliable software and hardware solutions

[ Contact Us ][23]

## More About Our Track and Trace Solutions

About Our Hardware

Lowry Solutions is technology agnostic and will equip you with whatever hardware and software
solutions are necessary to run your business at peak performance. 

Lowry Solutions is a partner to Zebra, Honeywell, Impinj, Microsoft, Getac, and more. 

Drawing upon our many domains of expertise, we will set you up with a customized set of asset
tracking devices designed for your unique business needs.

Specializing in end-to-end supply chain solutions, Lowry Solutions can equip your business with:
* Barcode scanners
* Thermal printers
* Labels and ribbons
* RFID readers
* RFID asset tracking tags
* Industrial mobile computers
* Vehicle mount computer
* Rugged tablets
* Break-fix and technical support
* Lifecycle management
* And more

Our hybrid cloud solution, Sonaria, is an asset tracking software designed to centralize and
synthesize data from all of these endpoints, including [**RFID Technology**][24], to give you
real-time insights into your business operations.

[Female worker scanning package with barcode scanner while using]
[hand presses on world map with social media,Truck with Industrial Container Cargo for Logistic
Import Export at yard (Elements of this image furnished by NASA)]

## GPS Asset Tracking

Our inventory management software, Sonaria, is capable of GPS tracking. With active RFID tags or GPS
monitoring hardware, track your product across multiple locations and between locations. 

Our real-time locating system ensures that you can get up-to-the-minute insights on your entire
supply chain.

GPS asset tracking systems are not only important for performance insights, but also for quality
control. 

Nowadays, customers want real time insights as to where their products are in transit. 

Being able to answer these questions is becoming industry standard for customer service for sales
orders.

### Asset and Inventory Control

### Asset Management Software

A comprehensive asset tracking software is essential to preserving asset integrity and reliability
across your enterprise.  

From repair schedules to location services, you need asset management software that saves you time
and money.

An asset management software lets you reduce manual processes and downtime. Improve data accuracy
and save time and money with automated asset tracking.

No more endless searches for parts and equipment.

### Inventory Tracking Software

Inventory control is critical to any supply chain operation. It ensures you have adequate inventory
without excess.  

In order to successfully manage inventory control, you need a comprehensive inventory management
system.

From raw materials to finished goods, warehouse to retail, you need a comprehensive overview of your
inventory at every stage of the supply chain.

Never run out of inventory again with 100% visibility.

### Interested in Partnering with Lowry Solutions?

Reach out today to find out how Lowry Solutions can improve your supply chain.

[ Contact Us ][25]

## Frequently asked questions

What does Lowry Solutions actually do?

Lowry helps businesses track assets and inventory using RFID, barcodes, GPS, and smart software, so
nothing gets lost and operations run smoothly.

How is Sonaria different from other tracking software?

Sonaria pulls data from multiple tracking technologies into one clear dashboard, giving real-time
visibility without switching between systems.

Can Lowry work with our existing systems?

Absolutely. Lowry’s solutions can easily integrate with ERP and WMS platforms, so that you do not
need to discard what is already functioning.

Which industries use Lowry Solutions?

Manufacturing, storage, healthcare, retail, transport, automotive, and state institutions are among
the sectors that depend on Lowry’s daily support.

Does Lowry Solutions provide ongoing support?

Certainly. Lowry Solutions will provide full support from installation through system maintenance to
ensure the reliability and timeliness of updates for your systems.

Our **software** helps find the true cost and margins made from

your purchases, by tracking the supplier lots through all stages of

production. By doing this we can show you exactly how much of what you spend is

turned into profit, and what’s not being used.

We understand that the industry is dealing with labor shortages and turnovers

that lead to a ‘lack of experience’ issues. To help with these problems,

Merit-Trax Technologies works with our customers to make changes

to their operating procedures, which in conjunction with

Augmented Intelligence software modifications that we do,

it enables companies to meet increased demands with fewer staff.


Our software helps to meet **FSMA** and **SFCR** requirements.



The **FDA** has finalized and integrated seven major rules to implement FSMA,

recognizing that ensuring the safety of the food supply is a shared responsibility

among many different points in the global food supply chain.



The FSMA rules are designed to make clear specific actions that

must be taken critical points to prevent contamination and ensure easier traceability.



The **Safe Food** for **Canadians Regulations** (SFCR) were designed to improve

food product quality and safety for Canadian customers. To be licensed,

companies must have a rigorous food safety program based on

the Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) methodology.



These food safety regulations are continually being updated and having boosted rules added to be
enforced.






When it comes to the food business and consumers, they want to know

that they can trust the companies that are supplying the public.



Not only is having software that meets traceability and regulation requirements a way

to establish that consumer confidence, but it is also bottom line proficient

in helping you make the best production decisions to maximise potential profit and proficiency.


Each TRAX-IT software module **integrates** **production management**, **quality assurance** and
**traceability data collection** which stores the data in one integrated database. This integrated
database amplifies your business management capabilities using dynamic reports, dashboards, and key
performance indicators in real time.


Merit-Trax Technologies is a **recognized expert** and contributor for the implementation of
barcode, RFID and traceability technology in the food industry. Merit-Trax works with food industry
companies and associations to ensure that it provides the maximum benefits of food software systems.

**Merit-Trax Technologies Food Software Assisted Intelligence and Augmented Intelligence systems **


Extensive amounts of business sectors are realizing the **necessity of their adaption** to
**advanced technologies** such as AI and **Assisted Intelligence** for **gaining leverage** over
their **production** and **sales revenue**, and for the Slaughterhouse

and Meat / Food Processing industry, it is no different.

## Partnership for Food Traceability

A non-profit partnership advancing a shared industry-wide vision for enhanced food traceability.

## FSMA 204 Pilot Program

The Partnership for Food Protection Pilot Committee is launching three pilots that allows the food
industry to test their FSMA 204 Traceability readiness and get feedback from peers and PFT members:
1. Lot code flexibilities in achieving FSMA 204 compliance.
2. Data population of an Electronic Sortable Spreadsheet.
3. Interoperable data exchange.

Please watch this video to learn more about PFT, these pilots, and how to participate!
 Participation is open to PFT members and non-members alike!  Let’s Pilot Together!

## ABOUT US

The Partnership for Food Traceability (PFT) is an independent, sector-neutral nonprofit developing a
shared, overarching vision for food traceability across the supply chain. PFT’s membership includes
industry members, trade associations, and technology vendors from all sectors and industries of the
food supply chain with support from FDA, State, and local food officials.

## 2026 PFT-FDA Town Halls

PFT and FDA will host two town halls on [Food Traceability Rule implementation efforts in 2026][9].
The town halls will provide a forum for FDA to hear from stakeholders and better understand the
challenges, as well as identify and discuss potential solutions and flexibilities for satisfying the
rule’s lot-level tracking requirements.

[ Learn More ][10]

## Why Join?

Be a part of the group developing baseline cross-industry, cross-sector business and functional
requirements that will support compliance with the FSMA traceability rule and business-to-business
traceability requirements. You will have a direct impact on industry-wide practices to ensure
interoperable solutions work for your company and business needs.

Have a voice in setting industry-wide traceability practices

Access insights from peers and FDA

Efficient, accurate, scalable implementation processes

## The RFgen Difference

**Built to power resilient, flexible, and secure supply chain operations**

Every supply chain operates differently. That’s why RFgen is built to flex around your systems, your
people, and your goals; giving you the tools to work smarter, scale faster, and stay in control.

[Fits Your Operation, No Matter How Complex]

### Fits Your Operation, No Matter How Complex

Custom workflows, paper processes, multiple locations, and hybrid environments? No problem. [RFgen’s
MobileEdge™ Suites][100] apps are flexible enough to optimize the way you work today, helping you
eliminate manual processes and streamline execution without forcing change where it’s not needed.

[Extends the Value of Your ERP]

### Extends the Value of Your ERP

Maximize your ERP investment by extending its capabilities to the point of work. RFgen empowers your
teams with real-time data capture, mobile flexibility, and operational agility, turning your ERP
into a driver of productivity across your entire supply chain.

[Keeps Running, Even When the Network Doesn’t]

### Keeps Running, Even When the Network Doesn’t

Lost connectivity shouldn’t bring your operation to a halt. RFgen enables offline data capture,
ensuring you can keep scanning, tracking, and updating inventory, even in low-signal or no-Wi-Fi
environments.

[Secures Every Connection]

### Secures Every Connection

RFgen is designed to protect your most critical systems and data. With built-in encryption,
role-based security, identity-based access, and zero-trust architecture, you stay secure across
every user, device, and workflow, no matter where work happens.

[Future-Ready by Design]

### Future-Ready by Design

RFgen brings together barcode scanning, RFID, GPS, enterprise labeling, and other advanced features
in a single mobile platform. As supply chain technology advances, we keep you one step ahead with
clean, connected data at the source, so you’re always ready for what’s next.

[Built on Real Experience, Not Guesswork]

### Built on Real Experience, Not Guesswork

With over 40 years in the field, RFgen is shaped by real-world operations and continuous
collaboration with our customers. From solving fulfillment delays to improving inventory accuracy,
we bring proven solutions backed by a support team that’s with you for the long haul.

challenges.**

You’ve invested in a powerful system. RFgen extends it with mobile execution and real-time data
capture, so your ERP stays accurate, responsive, and connected.

## The RFgen Difference

**Built to power resilient, flexible, and secure supply chain operations**

Every supply chain operates differently. That’s why RFgen is built to flex around your systems, your
people, and your goals; giving you the tools to work smarter, scale faster, and stay in control.

[Fits Your Operation, No Matter How Complex]

### Fits Your Operation, No Matter How Complex

Custom workflows, paper processes, multiple locations, and hybrid environments? No problem. [RFgen’s
MobileEdge™ Suites][100] apps are flexible enough to optimize the way you work today, helping you
eliminate manual processes and streamline execution without forcing change where it’s not needed.

[Extends the Value of Your ERP]

### Extends the Value of Your ERP

Maximize your ERP investment by extending its capabilities to the point of work. RFgen empowers your
teams with real-time data capture, mobile flexibility, and operational agility, turning your ERP
into a driver of productivity across your entire supply chain.

[Keeps Running, Even When the Network Doesn’t]

### Keeps Running, Even When the Network Doesn’t

Lost connectivity shouldn’t bring your operation to a halt. RFgen enables offline data capture,
ensuring you can keep scanning, tracking, and updating inventory, even in low-signal or no-Wi-Fi
environments.

[Secures Every Connection]

### Secures Every Connection

RFgen is designed to protect your most critical systems and data. With built-in encryption,
role-based security, identity-based access, and zero-trust architecture, you stay secure across
every user, device, and workflow, no matter where work happens.

[Future-Ready by Design]

### Future-Ready by Design

RFgen brings together barcode scanning, RFID, GPS, enterprise labeling, and other advanced features
in a single mobile platform. As supply chain technology advances, we keep you one step ahead with
clean, connected data at the source, so you’re always ready for what’s next.

[Built on Real Experience, Not Guesswork]

### Built on Real Experience, Not Guesswork

With over 40 years in the field, RFgen is shaped by real-world operations and continuous
collaboration with our customers. From solving fulfillment delays to improving inventory accuracy,
we bring proven solutions backed by a support team that’s with you for the long haul.

What is Slideshare?

Slideshare is the presentation-sharing platform for anyone looking for slide inspiration, to
showcase their knowledge, or to build on their own ideas. With over 25M+ presentations and 70M+
active users, Slideshare is the place where big ideas live.

Why does Slideshare look different?

love remains the same — access to over 25 million decks, powerful AI tools, and a global network of

Do I need a subscription to access Slideshare?

No subscription is required to access Slideshare — you can still browse, read, and upload content.

How do I cancel my subscription?
